TRI-COUNTY REGIONAL PLANNING COMMISSION
(CUMBERLAND, DAUPHIN, and PERRY COUNTIES)
2001 NORTH FRONT STREET 
BLDG. #2 SUITE 221 
HARRISBURG, PENNSYLVANIA 17102
Staff Telephone 234-2639
July 23, 1973
Mr. James Corbin, Director
Department of Housing and Urban Development
Community Development Disaster Recovery Office
Lackawnna County Building
Spruce and Adams Avenue
Scranton, Pa. 18503
Subject: Draft Environmental Statement
Penn Susquehanna Urban Renewal Project
Harrisburg, Pennsylvania HUD Project No. PA-R-634C
Dear Mr. Corbin:
We received your letter and Draft Environmental Impact statement for the above project on June 30, 1973
Copies of the letter, title page and table of contents of the 115 page report have been mailed to five other agencies, for review and comment, indicating that the report is available in this office for review. Copies of the five letters are attached. A copy of the comments of the Council of Human Services, addressed to Mr. Traussi and a copy of the comments of the Chairman of the Commission's Committee on Housing are also enclosed.
The Regional Planning Commission and staff have reviewed this material and the Commission's comments are reported below:
   The proposed plan conforms to the generalized land use plan of the City of Harrisburg and Tri-County Regional Planning Commission for the City of Harrisburg.
2. The environmental impact of the proposed plan would be an improvement over the existing conditions, which have developed over the years by the construction of buildings and streets within this portion of the City of Harrisburg. For this reason, any plan which proposes some increase in open space or reduction in the density of development would improve the environmental impact of this area on both natural conditions and on those citizens who may live and work in the Penn-Susquehanna Urban Renewal Area.
The Regional Planning Commission believes that the improvements of this area as proposed are reasonable solutions to this problem area.
Sincerely yours,
107105 George S. Jennings
